title: tragia nepetifolia var. angustifolia
intro: Tragia nepetifolia var. angustifolia, commonly known as Tragia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Euphorbiaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Tragia include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and provide relief from respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Tragia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
